result.summary: Identified two visual issues regarding text legibility and carousel spacing.

issues.description: Promo banner headline and subtext have insufficient contrast against the light green background.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text or a deeper background color to improve readability.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' row clips abruptly at the right screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right padding or a fade effect to indicate horizontal scroll.
